name: The Best Carpet for Homes With Pets
title-tag: The Best Carpet for Pets: A Contractor's Honest Guide
meta-description: The best pet carpet is solution-dyed fiber over a moisture-barrier pad — the pad is where odor wins or loses. Fibers ranked honestly, warranties decoded.
post-summary: September 10, 2026 · The best carpet for pets is a solution-dyed fiber — triexta or solution-dyed nylon — over a moisture-barrier pad, and the pad matters more than the carpet: accidents that reach the subfloor are where permanent odor lives. Fibers ranked, warranties decoded, and the spec we install in pet households.
